proposition: The K. al-Mafāḥiṣ was completed in 823/1420, but the day and the sense of the date are disputed inside the entry: MS Landberg 146 gives 1 Shaʿbān 823, MS Majlis 10196 gives 19 Dhū l-Ḥijja 823 (a date supported by the Riyāḍ al-ʿUlamāʾ), yet a marginal correction to the Majlis autograph colophon says that date refers to copying (taswīd) only; the work was revised and expanded in 828/1425 in the presence of Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī, and the place is 'perhaps' Isfahan or Yazd.

mediation.who: MS Landberg 146 and MS Majlis 10196 colophons
mediation.note: the two colophons differ; the marginal correction says one records copying
